_about: Content kept in data/gloss but left out of (or reworded in) the built app data by scripts/build_data.py, so the shipped text suits young children. Every rule must still match the gloss, or the build fails. See README > Hidden content.

hideSteinsaltz._about: Mishnayos whose Steinsaltz text (stIntro, st, stMore) is dropped. Their pieces then show only the simple meaning, with no Steinsaltz toggle.
hideSteinsaltz.5:2: Steinsaltz describes a hermaphrodite as having both male and female sexual organs.
hideSteinsaltz.6:1: Steinsaltz names bestiality (an animal that copulated with a person) and payment to a prostitute.
hideSteinsaltz.6:2: Steinsaltz speaks of payment to a prostitute and of a maidservant who will lie with a slave and engage in intercourse.
hideSteinsaltz.6:3: Steinsaltz speaks of payment for intercourse with a dog and the price of a prostitute.
hideSteinsaltz.6:4: Steinsaltz speaks of paying a prostitute for her services.
hideSteinsaltz.7:4: Steinsaltz names a miscarried fetus and placenta, an ox stoned for killing a person, and a corpse found with an unknown killer.
hideSteinsaltz.7:6: Steinsaltz mentions a woman who miscarried and whether it was a fetus.
